title: Development of Bohyunsan Observatory Echelle Spectrograph
what_was_studied: Optical layout, fibre modes, wavelength coverage and commissioning performance
numerical_result: BOES covers about 350 to 1050 nm with resolving powers of about 30000, 45000 or 90000 depending on fibre
remaining_question: How stable is each fibre mode over nights and instrument interventions?

title: Planetary companions in K giants beta Cancri mu Leonis and beta Ursae Minoris
what_was_studied: Long-baseline iodine-cell velocities from the BOES giant-star programme
numerical_result: The study used BOES observations obtained from 2003 to 2013 and reported periodic RV signals for three K giants
remaining_question: How much of each long-period signal remains after activity and sampling tests?

title: BOES instrument characteristics
authors: Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute
what_was_studied: Installed hardware, fibre choices, wavelength range and iodine-cell performance statement
numerical_result: KASI lists 360 to 1050 nm, resolving powers of 30000, 45000 and 90000, and iodine-cell RV precision below 5 m/s
remaining_question: The page is not a dated long-term stability experiment or a dated availability notice
